text: Using gpt2-medium as the weak supervisor and llama-3.1-8b as the strong student, we trained only a linear head on frozen strong features with a probe learning rate of 0.01, averaging over num_seeds = 3 seeds. The weak supervisor reached 0.58 accuracy and the strong model's ceiling was 0.88, while the weak-to-strong transfer accuracy was 0.71 with a standard error of 0.02. This corresponds to a performance gap recovered of 0.43 with a standard error of 0.05, against a baseline PGR of 0.22. The margin over the baseline exceeds twice the reported standard error of the PGR estimate, so the linear-probe setup appears to recover more of the gap than the baseline here. That said, the evidence rests on only three seeds, the standard error is itself estimated from that small sample, and no variance figure is given for the baseline, so the size of the effect should be treated as provisional pending replication with more seeds.
